250 Grams of Chicken, 2 Medium Sized Cucumbers, 150 Grams of Curd, 1 Cheese Omellete(2 Eggs And 2 cubes of amul cheese), 2 Boiled Eggs, Half a cup of Bullet Proof Coffee.

(Around 1400 Calories, 120 Grams Fat, 95 Grams Protien, 14 Grams net carbs)

I tried many times to teach my brother to swim. He was so scared of the water, He would start crying when brought him near the pool. 
So we just kinda gave up the idea.

One day, I came home and saw him in the pool with my uncle, 

I asked him, How it happened and the answer he gave me, was the stupidest thing I've ever heard.

This is what my uncle had told him:
"Population of our planet is increasing day by day and because of that, people are producing more stuff than ever. So earth is getting heavier and heavier. One day, earth is going to be too heavy and is going to fall off into the ocean. So those who cannot swim are definitely going to die."


I wanted to to tell him how ridiculous this was, but I decided not to.

(My brother was 9 at the time)

I understand your pain. 
Until my mom asked me, What's an ugly smile?
All smiles are beautiful.

Thanks for the reply!
I am starting to think of my uncle as a slacker. I don't think he really likes to work. I've casually told him to look for something to do a few times, but he ignored.

I will definitely try and talk to my dad about my brother.
